name: Forbiddance

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: ruby dust worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

targets.description: an area of ground you touch

summary: Ward an area against teleportation, planar travel and creature types you choose.
text: The area is up to 40,000 square feet and 30 feet high. Chosen types (Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends or Undead) take 5d10 Radiant or Necrotic damage when they first enter it on a turn or end a turn there; a password lets a creature through unharmed. Casting it daily for 30 days makes it last until dispelled.
